## Description

Extracts 1-dimensional Betti persistence landscapes from sliding multi-asset correlation point clouds, quantifying cyclic structural stress and market contagion prior to global macro liquidity crunches.

## Where it may fit

Pre-crash global macro environments, systemic credit crunches, complex inter-market correlation breakdowns.

## Vehicles

Global Macro Hedge Funds, Tail-Risk Funds, Institutional Risk Management Desks.

## Required data

Rolling cross-asset correlation matrices, multivariate asset return time series.

Persistence landscape vector norm calculations require efficient vectorization for real-time tracking.
